cases.title: A 200 with a bounded summary is complete and usable
A 200 with a partial summary is complete but not usable
A completed summary that did not pass its scope is not usable
Without a key the client generates one, sends it and returns it
Run options and a pinned major go into the body; deprecation headers are surfaced
A 202 is followed by GET /result with the same key after Retry-After; the POST is never resent
Without Retry-After the wait is run.poll_after_seconds, clamped to 1..60
Without Retry-After or poll_after_seconds the wait is 30 seconds
A 409 result_not_available/complete/running on /result is pending, not an error: same key again

detail.message: The result is not available yet. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
The run has not finished yet. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

cases.spec_note: The current engine answers 202 while a run goes on; these 409 codes come from an older delivery path (FINDINGS.md, finding 6). Clients keep tolerating them.

cases.title: wait=false asks the server not to hold the request (wait_seconds 0) and returns the 202 as an incomplete result
When the next wait would pass poll_timeout the client returns the incomplete result instead of sleeping
catalog.result reads an earlier run by key (recovery after a timeout) and polls until it ends
